title: Python
text: Python is a programming language used for machine learning, data analysis, automation, and web development.

title: Machine Learning
text: Machine learning allows computers to learn patterns from data and make predictions without being explicitly programmed.

title: Deep Learning
text: Deep learning uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn complex patterns from large amounts of data.

title: SQL
text: SQL is used to store, retrieve, modify, and analyze structured data in relational databases.

title: Vector Database
text: A vector database stores numerical representations of data called embeddings and allows similarity search.
